prayerExcerpt.en-US: "God is not pleased that I should deny Jesus my Saviour. To shed my blood for my faith is the most ardent desire of my heart."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Não agrada a Deus que eu renegue Jesus, meu Salvador. Derramar o meu sangue pela minha fé é o desejo mais vivo do meu coração."

meta.face: An Armenian archbishop of about forty-six with a warm, light-olive complexion and a FULL, SOFT OVAL face with rounded cheeks — a high, smooth forehead under the hood, no hair showing, large, dark, HEAVY-LIDDED eyes with a calm, slightly lowered gaze under thick, gently arched black brows, a straight nose with a broad tip, and a LONG, FULL, dense black BEARD, broad and squared at the bottom and reaching to the breast, with a full moustache over a closed mouth; the expression mild and resolute. Not the lean, narrow josaphat, nor the wide-open eyes of gregory_narek.
meta.basis: His photograph of 1911 (Wikimedia Commons, from the diocese of Mardin) and the Dicastery's portrait from it: a full, soft oval face with heavy-lidded dark eyes, thick arched brows, a straight broad-tipped nose and a long, dense black beard, in the black veghar hood with a pectoral cross (the Ottoman decorations on his breast are left out). John Paul II's homily gives his age at death as forty-six.
meta.excerpt: His answer to those who pressed him to deny the faith, as John Paul II quoted it at his beatification (homily of 7 October 2001; Italian on the Dicastery's page, «A Dio non piace che io rinneghi Gesù mio Salvatore. Versare il mio sangue a favore della mia fede è il più vivo desiderio del mio cuore»); en-US and pt-BR our renderings from the Italian (he died in 1915), so no Vatican translation enters the data
